description.text:
As the Director of Engineering for the Local Acquisition and Monetization group, I am responsible for getting new businesses onto the platform, onboarding them, and converting them to paying customers. This area of ownership covers marketing infrastructure, acquisition flows, in-product education, and self-serve advertising flows. My responsibilities previously included our Yelp Connect product, but that now lives in another part of the organization.

Through this, I still maintain my responsibility for Yelp for Restaurants, but with an additional layer of abstraction.

subComponents.title: Director Of Engineering - Yelp for Restaurants
subComponents.caption: Sep 2018 - Aug 2021 · 2 yrs 11 mos

description.text: I led engineering for Yelp for Restaurants for three years, taking ownership of the Yelp Reservations and Yelp Waitlist products. These were brought in-house via acquisition, and as such had disparate and non-Yelp-standard technical stacks. My job was to pull these pieces into a coherent product backed by a well-supported technical foundation while continuing to advance our position in the restaurant front of house SaaS market.

As the Head of Engineering for Yelp Hamburg, I was responsible for building out the engineering teams to support our mid-market and enterprise advertising products, along with supporting the existing local advertising product. Through that time, I built up our European recruiting team, developed a full internship program, and was responsible for hiring non-engineering staff including people operations, office management, product management, and more.

While on the consumer side of the product, I managed multiple teams through a variety of reorganizations. The teams I was responsible for over this time had ownership of the general web-based portion of the product, the contribution flows across all platforms, and the community features.

As an engineer, I led the creation of our review origin tracking system, migrated career tooling from Jobvite to Lever, and worked on large refactoring projects involving the write-a-review flow and our transition to service oriented architecture.

I started a small contracting firm to support some existing customers from Idea Tree when that firm shut down. This was primarily PHP and JavaScript development with the AngularJS framework.

At the same time, I used this as an opportunity to work on some independent game development.
